analysis: Format: square multi-panel static ad collage with a bold central headline, UGC testimonial card, product packs in background, and a 3-column benefit strip footer. Family: transformation/testimonial performance ad. Mechanism zones: top-left and bottom-left show product/action benefits; top-right shows user delight/consumption; center is social proof testimonial; bottom strip is benefit summary. For Edenvia, left/before zones become heavy swollen legs/water retention suffering; right/after zones become lighter legs, slimmer ankles, boots zip, one tablet a day. The testimonial card should be the avatar speaking in first person. No rival needed because template is not comparison-based.
